title: Metering Service Schedule of Accuracy Test Terms
content:
Accuracy tolerance, test method and test charges for every meter type of the **Metering Service** are fixed per type as follows. A meter registers accurately when its registration lies within 100 percent plus or minus the type's tolerance, in percentage points.

## Tolerance, method and timing

| Meter type | Accuracy tolerance (percentage points) | Accurate band of registration | Test method of the type (where a customer-requested test is performed) | Business days after the request within which the test is performed | Customer may witness the test | Meter found non-registering or outside tolerance is replaced within |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Communicating Opt-Out Meter | 2.0 | 98.00 to 102.00 | Meter shop (meter exchanged and shop-tested) | 10 | Yes | 5 business days |
| Standard AMI Smart Meter | 2.0 | 98.00 to 102.00 | Meter shop | 10 | Yes | 5 business days |
| AMI Bidirectional Net Meter | 2.0 | 98.00 to 102.00 | Meter shop | 10 | Yes | 5 business days |
| AMI Three-Phase Commercial Meter | 2.0 | 98.00 to 102.00 | Field (tested in place) | 15 | Yes | 10 business days |
| AMI Interval Demand Meter | 1.0 | 99.00 to 101.00 | Field | 15 | Yes | 10 business days |
| Primary Metering Installation | 0.5 | 99.50 to 100.50 | Field | 20 | Yes | 10 business days |

## Free tests, repeat test fee and periodic testing

| Meter type | Free customer-requested tests per period | Free-test period (months) | Repeat test fee (USD) | Repeat test fee waived when the meter is found outside tolerance | Periodic test interval (years) | Fee for a periodic or utility-initiated test (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Communicating Opt-Out Meter | 1 | 12 | 45.00 | Yes | 0 (statistical sample testing only) | 0.00 |
| Standard AMI Smart Meter | 1 | 12 | 45.00 | Yes | 0 (statistical sample testing only) | 0.00 |
| AMI Bidirectional Net Meter | 1 | 12 | 45.00 | Yes | 0 (statistical sample testing only) | 0.00 |
| AMI Three-Phase Commercial Meter | 1 | 12 | 85.00 | Yes | 8 | 0.00 |
| AMI Interval Demand Meter | 1 | 12 | 150.00 | Yes | 4 | 0.00 |
| Primary Metering Installation | 1 | 12 | 375.00 | Yes | 2 | 0.00 |

A periodic test interval of 0 years means the type is not tested on an installation-by-installation schedule; it is covered by statistical sample testing only.

## Notes on the schedule

- **Band edges are inside the band.** For a type with a 2.0-point tolerance, a registration of exactly 98.00 or exactly 102.00 is accurate; 97.99 and 102.01 are not. For the Primary Metering Installation, 99.50 and 100.50 are accurate; 99.49 and 100.51 are not.
- **Periodic and utility-initiated tests are never charged.** Their fee is 0.00 for every type.
- **Hypothetical illustration.** A customer-requested test of an AMI Interval Demand Meter is performed in the field, may be witnessed, and, where it is chargeable as a repeat test, carries the 150.00 repeat test fee of that type.
